correctness.rationale: Every ideal is uniquely (S,T) with S subset seven points and T subset the lines C(S) contained in S; summing 2^|C(S)| gives 458. Minimal missing elements yield the explicit deterministic rowmotion transition ((P\S) union all points on C(S)\T, C(S)\T). Direct independent enumeration of all 458 ideals and cycles gives 29 3-cycles, 35 5-cycles and 28 7-cycles; the permutation order is lcm=105. All 168 invertible GF(2)^3 maps act on points and lines; the seven representative cycle orbits (1,14,14,7,7,21,28 cycles) cover disjointly all 458 ideal states. Inspected full verify.py and second independent C++ algorithm description. This is exhaustive finite proof by exact complete cover, not numerical sampling.
